state.paragraph: committing to fund 100% of the capital needed for closing, which, together with the all-cash per share purchase price of $21.25, we refer to as the CSC/Pamplona final proposal. The parties also agreed that the exclusivity agreement would automatically terminate if CSC or Pamplona adversely changed any of the terms of the CSC/Pamplona final proposal.

ledger_rows.Note: Raised from $20.75 (#35) the same day the committee asked. Conditioned on 2-week exclusivity; asks for voting agreements from MacDonald. Pamplona funds 100%, no financing contingency; confirmatory diligence only (Light).

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
